name: The Next Step
label: Quest
description: Following the resolution of the immediate beast threats near Thendal Village, Elder Aetheen of the Gales directs travelers southward toward Shen'dar…
intro: Following the resolution of the immediate beast threats near Thendal Village, Elder Aetheen of the Gales directs travelers southward toward Shen'dar Village. The journey marks a shift from clearing wild fauna to confronting the organized zealotry of the Al'Aketh Cult, who revere the Windlord Al'Akir.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
